index.title: Resources
index.lead: Things to listen to, watch and read between conversations, picked by the community. Each entry is marked with its language and level.
index.summary_one: {{count}} entry so far, in Spanish, English or both.

index.suggest: Know something that belongs here? Suggest it in the server.

podcasts.title: Podcasts
podcasts.body: Lessons, conversations and long-form stories, from beginner shows to Radio Ambulante.
podcasts.lead: Shows to learn Spanish and English by ear. Open one and it plays on the show's own site.
podcasts.imageAlt: A radio announcer reading a script at a studio desk with a gooseneck microphone, 1930s

youtube.title: YouTube channels
youtube.body: Channels that teach the language, and channels that are simply good to listen to.
youtube.lead: Channels to watch in Spanish and English, from lessons to everyday vlogs. Each opens on YouTube.
youtube.imageAlt: A family gathered around an early television set, 1950s

movies.title: Movies
movies.body: Films in Spanish and in English, for listening practice with subtitles or without.
movies.lead: Films to practise listening. Each opens on IMDb, where you can see where to watch it.
movies.imageAlt: The facade of Cine Cataluña on Avenida Corrientes in Buenos Aires, with film posters above the entrance, 1929

books.title: Books
books.body: Graded readers, short stories and novels worth the effort, by level.
books.lead: Books to read in Spanish and English, from graded readers to novels. Each opens on the publisher's or a bookshop's page.
books.imageAlt: Readers at long tables in a library reading room, early twentieth century

workbooks.title: Grammar and exercise books
workbooks.body: Textbooks, grammar references and workbooks with exercises and answer keys.
workbooks.lead: Books to study with: grammars, exercise books and course books, sorted by level.
workbooks.imageAlt: Schoolchildren writing at wooden desks in a classroom, early twentieth century

musicians.title: Musicians
musicians.body: Artists whose lyrics are clear enough to learn from, in every genre.
musicians.lead: Artists to listen to in Spanish and English. Look up the lyrics and sing along; it works.
musicians.imageAlt: A group of musicians with guitars and a double bass performing, mid-twentieth century
